verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own llms.txt documents a first-party MCP channel on its REST API that connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client, and links a dedicated developer docs page (tools/mcp). That is a direct, official MCP server offering. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's tools, scopes and auth setup in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developer.moneybird.com/tools/mcp): connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client.
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
